rules.detail: Vehicles book a morning slot (6 am to noon) or afternoon slot (1 pm to 6 pm). Each slot takes 600 vehicles, 100 of them two-wheelers.

gaps: No official page found for the toll amount for motorcycles at Mullayanagiri; the booking form shows it only after a slot is picked.
Counts of hairpin bends on the Agumbe ghat differ: a newspaper says about 16, a trail guide seen only in search results says 14.
No source found for forest check post timings at Agumbe (Someshwara) or on the Mullayanagiri road beyond the slot hours.
No government order found for the Nagarahole gate hours or the two-wheeler restriction on the Kutta road; the second rests on a travel wiki alone.
Nothing found for Sringeri or Madikeri: no rule specific to motorcycles, and no entry fee from an official page.
The best months are sourced for Agumbe only, not for Coorg or Chikkamagaluru.
No source found for the usual number of days riders take.
Hairpin bend counts are added as header.hairpin_bends, which is not in the schema example.
No video kept for the Agumbe ghat or Coorg; filming dates of the two videos are not known.
